# Overview

HT1080 **LOY vs sgCTRL** RNA-seq analysis (AUG 2025 batch — reprocessed under
the standardized STAR two-pass + featureCounts v2.1.1 / GENCODE v49 pipeline).
HT1080 is a fibrosarcoma line carrying activating **NRAS Q61K** with wild-type
p53. LOY was generated by transient nucleofection of a Y-chromosome-targeting
sgRNA; sgCTRL is the matched non-targeting sgRNA control; PARENTAL is the
unmodified parental population. Three replicates per group were grown in
parallel and sequenced in the same batch.

**Design.** PARENTAL samples are retained in the DGEList (gene filtering, TMM,
PCA-all-samples, dispersion estimation) but are **excluded from the contrast**:
the differential expression test is strictly `LOY − CTRL`. The DE model
includes the replicate number as a paired block (`~ 0 + treatment + passage`)
so per-passage drift is removed before testing.

Every figure is saved to `figures_LOY_sgCTRL/` as both PNG (for iterative review)
and PDF (for publication).

| Group     | Samples | Y Status | Role |
|-----------|---------|----------|------|
| CTRL      | 3 (rep 1, 2, 3) | Y+ | sgRNA control (reference for the LOY-vs-sgCTRL contrast) |
| PARENTAL  | 3 (rep 1, 2, 3) | Y+ | Untreated; variance-estimation only, not in the contrast |
| LOY       | 3 (rep 1, 2, 3) | Y− | Y chromosome deleted |

## 1.2 Paths, Parameters, and PNG-First Figure Helper

```{r define-paths}
# --- Data root ---------------------------------------------------------
# Upstream pipeline outputs (featureCounts tables) live on the local
# Dropbox tree. Update this single line if data moves (e.g., to a central
# HPC mount or after GEO deposition at manuscript submission).
DATA_ROOT  <- "A:/Dropbox/LOY_paralogs/projects"
COUNTS_DIR <- file.path(DATA_ROOT, "RNAseq", "counts", "AUG_2025_HT1080_LOY")

# --- Output paths ------------------------------------------------------
# This Rmd renders from analysis/02_rnaseq/. All outputs are namespaced
# under HT1080/ inside that directory so A549/LNCaP/combined outputs
# (added later) don't collide. CSVs/RDSes are gitignored repo-wide;
# PNG/PDF figures are tracked.
BASE_DIR <- getwd()
CELL_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "HT1080")
DE_DIR   <- file.path(CELL_DIR, "DE")
GSEA_DIR <- file.path(CELL_DIR, "GSEA")
TF_DIR   <- file.path(CELL_DIR, "TF_analysis")
FIG_DIR  <- file.path(CELL_DIR, "figures_LOY_sgCTRL")

for (d in c(DE_DIR, GSEA_DIR, TF_DIR, FIG_DIR)) {
  if (!dir.exists(d)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE)
}

ALPHA     <- 0.05
LFC_THR   <- 0.75
MIN_COUNT <- 200

# Save every figure as both PNG (for review) and PDF (for publication)
save_fig <- function(plot, name, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, paste0(name, ".png")),
         plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
  ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, paste0(name, ".pdf")),
         plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi)
  cat(sprintf("Saved: %s.(png|pdf)  [%gx%g in]\n", name, width, height))
  invisible(plot)
}
```

## 1.3 Auto-generate Sample Metadata from Filenames

```{r build-samples}
count_files <- list.files(COUNTS_DIR,
                          pattern = "^HT1080.*\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
count_files <- count_files[!grepl("\\.summary$", count_files)]
stopifnot(length(count_files) == 9)

samples <- data.frame(
  sample_id = sub("\\.txt$", "", basename(count_files)),
  cell_line = "HT1080",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = case_when(
      grepl("-LOY-",      sample_id) ~ "LOY",
      grepl("-CTRL-",     sample_id) ~ "CTRL",
      grepl("-PARENTAL-", sample_id) ~ "PARENTAL",
      TRUE                            ~ NA_character_
    ),
    replicate = sub(".*-(\\d+)$", "\\1", sample_id),
    y_status  = ifelse(treatment == "LOY", "Y-", "Y+")
  )
stopifnot(!any(is.na(samples$treatment)))
stopifnot(all(grepl("^\\d+$", samples$replicate)))

samples %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            replicates = paste(sort(replicate), collapse = ", "),
            y_status = dplyr::first(y_status), .groups = "drop") %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "HT1080 Sample Summary")
```

## 1.4 Load Count Data

```{r load-counts}
cat("Loading", length(count_files), "HT1080 count files from\n  ",
    COUNTS_DIR, "\n")

genes <- ensembldb::genes(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86) %>% as.data.frame()

df_list <- lapply(count_files, function(f) {
  df <- fread(f, data.table = FALSE, header = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::select(1, 7)
  names(df) <- c("geneID", sub("\\.txt$", "", basename(f)))
  column_to_rownames(df, var = "geneID")
})

count_matrix <- do.call("cbind", df_list)
# Keep only Ensembl gene rows; drop any non-ENSG rows from featureCounts
count_matrix <- count_matrix[grepl("^ENSG", rownames(count_matrix)), ]

# Sanity: column order must match samples row order
stopifnot(identical(colnames(count_matrix), samples$sample_id))

cat("Loaded", nrow(count_matrix), "genes across",
    ncol(count_matrix), "samples\n")
```

***

# 2. QC: DGEList, Filter, TMM

## 2.1 Build DGEList (2-level treatment factor)

```{r create-dgelist}
# Treatment factor — 3 levels; PARENTAL kept for variance estimation, dropped
# from the contrast in section 4.
treatment <- factor(samples$treatment, levels = c("PARENTAL", "CTRL", "LOY"))
# Passage = replicate number, paired across treatments
passage   <- factor(samples$replicate, levels = c("1", "2", "3"))

dge <- DGEList(counts = count_matrix, group = treatment)
dge$samples$treatment <- treatment
dge$samples$passage   <- passage
dge$samples$y_status  <- samples$y_status

# Annotate genes
gene_ids_full  <- rownames(dge$counts)
gene_ids_clean <- gsub("\\.\\d+$", "", gene_ids_full)

match_idx <- match(gene_ids_clean, genes$gene_id)
gene_info <- genes[match_idx, ]
gene_info$gene_id <- ifelse(is.na(gene_info$gene_id),
                            gene_ids_clean, gene_info$gene_id)
rownames(gene_info) <- gene_ids_full
dge$genes <- gene_info

keep_genes <- !is.na(dge$genes$gene_name) & !is.na(dge$genes$entrezid)
cat("Removing", sum(!keep_genes), "genes without full annotation\n")
dge <- dge[keep_genes, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
cat("Genes remaining:", nrow(dge), "\n")
```

## 2.2 Filter Low-Expressed Genes

```{r filter-genes}
dge_unfiltered <- dge
keep <- filterByExpr(dge, group = treatment, min.total.count = MIN_COUNT)
dge  <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

cat("Before filtering:", nrow(dge_unfiltered), "\n")
cat("After filtering: ", nrow(dge), "\n")
```

## 2.3 TMM Normalization

```{r normalize}
dge  <- calcNormFactors(dge, method = "TMM")
lcpm <- cpm(dge, log = TRUE)

dge$samples %>%
  dplyr::select(treatment, passage, lib.size, norm.factors) %>%
  mutate(
    lib.size_M    = round(lib.size / 1e6, 1),
    effective_lib = round(lib.size * norm.factors / 1e6, 1)
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Library sizes and normalization factors")
```

## 2.4 PCA {.tabset}

```{r pca-compute}
treatment_cols <- c("PARENTAL" = "#999999",
                    "CTRL"     = "#009E73",
                    "LOY"      = "#E69F00")

passage_shapes <- c("1" = 16, "2" = 17, "3" = 15)

# PCA helper: returns list(df, var_exp) for any DGEList subset
compute_pca <- function(dge_obj, ngenes = 2000) {
  logCPM <- cpm(dge_obj, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)
  ngenes <- min(ngenes, nrow(logCPM))
  var_genes <- sort(apply(logCPM, 1, var), decreasing = TRUE)
  X <- t(logCPM[names(var_genes)[1:ngenes], , drop = FALSE])
  pca <- prcomp(X, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
  list(
    df = cbind(dge_obj$samples, as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:3])) %>%
      rownames_to_column("sample"),
    var_exp = (pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2)
  )
}

# Plot helper: consistent styling across tabs
plot_pca <- function(pca_obj, x_pc = "PC1", y_pc = "PC2",
                     title, subtitle = NULL) {
  xi <- as.integer(sub("PC", "", x_pc))
  yi <- as.integer(sub("PC", "", y_pc))
  hull_df <- pca_obj$df %>%
    group_by(treatment) %>%
    dplyr::slice(chull(.data[[x_pc]], .data[[y_pc]])) %>%
    ungroup()

  ggplot(pca_obj$df,
         aes(.data[[x_pc]], .data[[y_pc]])) +
    geom_polygon(data = hull_df,
                 aes(x = .data[[x_pc]], y = .data[[y_pc]],
                     fill = treatment, group = treatment),
                 alpha = 0.25, color = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE,
                 show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(color = treatment, shape = passage), size = 4) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = sample),
                    size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf, color = "black") +
    scale_color_manual(values = treatment_cols) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = treatment_cols, guide = "none") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = passage_shapes, name = "Passage") +
    labs(
      title    = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = paste0(x_pc, " (",
                 round(pca_obj$var_exp[xi] * 100, 1), "%)"),
      y = paste0(y_pc, " (",
                 round(pca_obj$var_exp[yi] * 100, 1), "%)")
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12)
}

pca_all <- compute_pca(dge)

# LOY+CTRL subset — re-run prcomp on the 6-sample subset so PC axes reflect
# only LOY-vs-sgCTRL biology + passage drift (not PARENTAL effects)
dge_lc_pca <- dge[, dge$samples$treatment %in% c("LOY", "CTRL")]
dge_lc_pca$samples$treatment <- droplevels(dge_lc_pca$samples$treatment)
pca_lc <- compute_pca(dge_lc_pca)
```

### All samples — PC1 vs PC2

```{r pca-pc12, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
p_pc12 <- plot_pca(
  pca_all, "PC1", "PC2",
  title    = "HT1080 PCA — all samples (top 2000 variable genes)",
  subtitle = "Shape = passage (paired block); color = treatment"
)
print(p_pc12)
save_fig(p_pc12, "pca_pc1_pc2", width = 7, height = 5)
```

### All samples — PC1 vs PC3

PC2 is often dominated by passage drift. PC3 may resolve treatment biology
more cleanly once passage variance is partitioned out.

```{r pca-pc13, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
p_pc13 <- plot_pca(
  pca_all, "PC1", "PC3",
  title    = "HT1080 PCA — all samples, PC1 vs PC3",
  subtitle = "Shape = passage (paired block); color = treatment"
)
print(p_pc13)
save_fig(p_pc13, "pca_pc1_pc3", width = 7, height = 5)
```

### LOY vs sgCTRL only — PC1 vs PC2

PARENTAL samples dropped; `prcomp` re-run on the 6-sample subset so PC axes
reflect only LOY-vs-sgCTRL biology + passage drift.

```{r pca-lc-pc12, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
p_lc_12 <- plot_pca(
  pca_lc, "PC1", "PC2",
  title    = "HT1080 PCA — LOY and sgCTRL only (top 2000 variable genes)",
  subtitle = "Shape = passage (paired block); color = treatment"
)
print(p_lc_12)
save_fig(p_lc_12, "pca_loy_ctrl_pc1_pc2", width = 7, height = 5)
```

### LOY vs sgCTRL only — PC1 vs PC3

```{r pca-lc-pc13, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
p_lc_13 <- plot_pca(
  pca_lc, "PC1", "PC3",
  title    = "HT1080 PCA — LOY and sgCTRL only, PC1 vs PC3",
  subtitle = "Shape = passage (paired block); color = treatment"
)
print(p_lc_13)
save_fig(p_lc_13, "pca_loy_ctrl_pc1_pc3", width = 7, height = 5)
```

## 2.5 Sample distance heatmap

```{r sample-distance, fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
sample_dist <- as.matrix(dist(t(lcpm)))
rownames(sample_dist) <- colnames(lcpm)
colnames(sample_dist) <- colnames(lcpm)

ann_col <- data.frame(
  Treatment = dge$samples$treatment,
  Passage   = as.character(dge$samples$passage),
  row.names = colnames(sample_dist)
)
ann_colors <- list(
  Treatment = treatment_cols,
  Passage   = c("1" = "#CCCCCC", "2" = "#888888", "3" = "#444444")
)

pal <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(9, "Blues")))(255)
pheatmap(sample_dist,
         color = pal,
         annotation_col = ann_col,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         show_colnames = FALSE,
         cellwidth = 25,
         cellheight = 25,
         main = "HT1080 Sample Distance Matrix")
```

# 3. Y Chromosome Expression

Sanity check: LOY samples should show markedly lower expression of Y-chromosome
protein-coding genes than sgCTRL.

```{r y-chromosome, fig.height=3.5, fig.width=5}
chrY_info <- genes %>%
  dplyr::filter(seqnames == "Y", gene_biotype == "protein_coding") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_name, start) %>%
  arrange(start)

chrY_genes <- chrY_info$gene_name

# Build a symbol-keyed logCPM matrix for Y-gene extraction
lcpm_sym_qc <- lcpm
rownames(lcpm_sym_qc) <- dge$genes$gene_name
y_lcpm <- lcpm_sym_qc[rownames(lcpm_sym_qc) %in% chrY_genes, , drop = FALSE]

cat("Y chromosome genes in data:", nrow(y_lcpm), "/",
    length(chrY_genes), "\n")

gene_order <- chrY_info %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene_name %in% rownames(y_lcpm)) %>%
  pull(gene_name)
y_lcpm_ordered <- y_lcpm[gene_order, , drop = FALSE]

max_val <- quantile(y_lcpm_ordered, 0.95)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(min(y_lcpm_ordered), 2, 4, 6, max_val),
  c("#440154", "#3B528B", "#21908C", "#5DC863", "#FDE725")
)

clean_labels <- paste0(samples$treatment, "-", samples$replicate)
colnames(y_lcpm_ordered) <- clean_labels

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Treatment = samples$treatment,
  Passage   = samples$replicate,
  col = list(Treatment = treatment_cols,
             Passage   = ann_colors$Passage),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
  simple_anno_size = unit(3, "mm")
)

ht <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  y_lcpm_ordered,
  name = "logCPM",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  clustering_distance_columns = "euclidean",
  clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2",
  top_annotation = ha,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
  column_names_rot = 45,
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "grey10", lwd = 0.5),
  column_title = "HT1080 Y Chromosome Expression",
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
    legend_height = unit(2, "cm")
  )
)

draw(ht, merge_legend = TRUE)
```

# 4. Differential Expression: LOY vs sgCTRL {.tabset}

Two designs are fit on `dge_lc` (Y-chromosome genes removed, TMM recalculated):
**paired** (treatment + passage) is the recommended primary analysis;
**unpaired** is shown for reference. Downstream GSEA in section 5+ uses the
paired results.

```{r de-setup}
chrY_gene_ids <- genes %>%
  dplyr::filter(seqnames == "Y") %>%
  pull(gene_id)

dge_lc <- dge
chrY_idx <- which(
  gsub("\\.\\d+$", "", rownames(dge_lc$counts)) %in% chrY_gene_ids)
if (length(chrY_idx) > 0) {
  cat("Removing", length(chrY_idx), "Y chromosome genes\n")
  dge_lc <- dge_lc[-chrY_idx, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
}

# Drop PARENTAL for the contrast — PARENTAL contributed to gene filtering
# (filterByExpr above) and TMM (initial calcNormFactors), but the contrast
# is strictly LOY - CTRL.
dge_lc <- dge_lc[, dge_lc$samples$treatment %in% c("CTRL", "LOY")]
dge_lc$samples$treatment <- droplevels(dge_lc$samples$treatment)
dge_lc$samples$passage   <- droplevels(dge_lc$samples$passage)
cat("DE working set: ", ncol(dge_lc), " samples (", paste(levels(dge_lc$samples$treatment), collapse = "/"), ")\n", sep = "")

dge_lc <- calcNormFactors(dge_lc, method = "TMM")

run_de_contrast <- function(dge_obj, design, contrast_name = "LOY - CTRL") {
  cm  <- makeContrasts(contrasts = contrast_name, levels = colnames(design))
  v   <- voom(dge_obj, design, plot = FALSE)
  fit <- lmFit(v, design) %>%
    contrasts.fit(cm) %>%
    eBayes()
  topTable(fit, coef = 1, n = Inf, sort.by = "P") %>%
    dplyr::rename(PValue = P.Value, FDR = adj.P.Val, logCPM = AveExpr)
}

make_volcano <- function(de, title, fdr_thr = ALPHA,
                         lfc_thr = LFC_THR, n_label = 50) {
  d <- de %>%
    mutate(
      nlp = -log10(pmax(PValue, 1e-300)),
      sig = FDR < fdr_thr & abs(logFC) >= lfc_thr,
      direction = case_when(
        sig & logFC >  lfc_thr ~ "Up in LOY",
        sig & logFC < -lfc_thr ~ "Down in LOY",
        TRUE                   ~ "NS"
      ),
      direction = factor(direction,
                         levels = c("Down in LOY", "NS", "Up in LOY"))
    )
  n_up   <- sum(d$direction == "Up in LOY")
  n_down <- sum(d$direction == "Down in LOY")
  top    <- d %>% dplyr::filter(sig) %>% slice_min(PValue, n = n_label)
  cols   <- c("Down in LOY" = "#0072B2", "NS" = "grey80",
              "Up in LOY"   = "#D55E00")

  ggplot(d, aes(x = logFC, y = nlp)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = direction), alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_thr, lfc_thr), linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = top, aes(label = gene_name),
      size = 3, fontface = "italic",
      max.overlaps = Inf, segment.color = "grey50", segment.size = 0.3,
      box.padding = 0.4, point.padding = 0.3, min.segment.length = 0.2,
      force = 2
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols, drop = FALSE) +
    annotate("text",
             x = max(d$logFC) * 0.85,
             y = max(d$nlp)   * 0.95,
             label = paste0("n = ", n_up),
             color = "#D55E00", fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
    annotate("text",
             x = min(d$logFC) * 0.85,
             y = max(d$nlp)   * 0.95,
             label = paste0("n = ", n_down),
             color = "#0072B2", fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
    labs(
      x = expression(log[2]~"Fold Change (LOY / sgCTRL)"),
      y = expression(-log[10]~"(P-value)"),
      title = title,
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.text     = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title      = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      axis.text       = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13)
    )
}
```

## Paired (treatment + passage)

Design: `~ 0 + treatment + passage`. Passage covariate absorbs per-passage drift
before the `LOY - CTRL` contrast.

```{r de-paired}
design_paired <- model.matrix(~ 0 + treatment + passage,
                              data = dge_lc$samples)
colnames(design_paired) <- gsub("^treatment", "", colnames(design_paired))
cat("Design columns:", paste(colnames(design_paired), collapse = ", "), "\n")

de_loy_ctrl_paired <- run_de_contrast(dge_lc, design_paired)

cat(sprintf("\nPaired DE — LOY vs sgCTRL: %d genes tested\n",
            nrow(de_loy_ctrl_paired)))
cat(sprintf("  FDR < 0.05:              %d\n",
            sum(de_loy_ctrl_paired$FDR < 0.05)))
cat(sprintf("  FDR < %g & |logFC| > %g:  %d (up: %d, down: %d)\n",
            ALPHA, LFC_THR,
            sum(de_loy_ctrl_paired$FDR < ALPHA &
                abs(de_loy_ctrl_paired$logFC) > LFC_THR),
            sum(de_loy_ctrl_paired$FDR < ALPHA &
                de_loy_ctrl_paired$logFC >  LFC_THR),
            sum(de_loy_ctrl_paired$FDR < ALPHA &
                de_loy_ctrl_paired$logFC < -LFC_THR)))

fwrite(de_loy_ctrl_paired,
       file.path(DE_DIR, "ht1080_LOY_v_sgCTRL_DE_paired.csv"))
```

```{r volcano-paired, fig.height=6, fig.width=7}
p_v_paired <- make_volcano(
  de_loy_ctrl_paired,
  "HT1080: LOY vs sgCTRL — Paired (treatment + passage)")
print(p_v_paired)
save_fig(p_v_paired, "volcano_LOY_v_sgCTRL_paired", width = 7, height = 6)
```

## Unpaired (treatment only)

Design: `~ 0 + treatment`. Passage drift not modeled — reference for what the
statistics look like without the covariate.

```{r de-unpaired}
design_unpaired <- model.matrix(~ 0 + treatment, data = dge_lc$samples)
colnames(design_unpaired) <- gsub("^treatment", "",
                                   colnames(design_unpaired))
cat("Design columns:", paste(colnames(design_unpaired), collapse = ", "), "\n")

de_loy_ctrl_unpaired <- run_de_contrast(dge_lc, design_unpaired)

cat(sprintf("\nUnpaired DE — LOY vs sgCTRL: %d genes tested\n",
            nrow(de_loy_ctrl_unpaired)))
cat(sprintf("  FDR < 0.05:              %d\n",
            sum(de_loy_ctrl_unpaired$FDR < 0.05)))
cat(sprintf("  FDR < %g & |logFC| > %g:  %d (up: %d, down: %d)\n",
            ALPHA, LFC_THR,
            sum(de_loy_ctrl_unpaired$FDR < ALPHA &
                abs(de_loy_ctrl_unpaired$logFC) > LFC_THR),
            sum(de_loy_ctrl_unpaired$FDR < ALPHA &
                de_loy_ctrl_unpaired$logFC >  LFC_THR),
            sum(de_loy_ctrl_unpaired$FDR < ALPHA &
                de_loy_ctrl_unpaired$logFC < -LFC_THR)))

fwrite(de_loy_ctrl_unpaired,
       file.path(DE_DIR, "ht1080_LOY_v_sgCTRL_DE_unpaired.csv"))
```

# 5. GSEA (Basic Collections)

## 5.1 Setup: ranks + basic pathways

```{r gsea-setup}
prep_ranks_t <- function(de_results, gene_col = "gene_name") {
  de_results %>%
    transmute(gene = .data[[gene_col]], stat = t) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene), is.finite(stat)) %>%
    group_by(gene) %>%
    summarize(stat = stat[which.max(abs(stat))], .groups = "drop") %>%
    { setNames(.$stat, .$gene) } %>%
    sort(decreasing = TRUE)
}

run_fgsea_all <- function(ranks, pathways_list, minSize = 15, maxSize = 500) {
  results <- lapply(names(pathways_list), function(name) {
    cat(sprintf("  Running %s (%d gene sets)...\n", name,
                length(pathways_list[[name]])))
    fgsea(pathways_list[[name]], ranks, minSize = minSize, maxSize = maxSize) %>%
      mutate(collection = name) %>%
      arrange(padj)
  })
  bind_rows(results)
}

cat("Loading basic MSigDB collections...\n")
collections <- list(
  hallmark = msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H"),
  reactome = msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C2",
                     subcategory = "CP:REACTOME"),
  kegg     = msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C2",
                     subcategory = "CP:KEGG_LEGACY"),
  go_bp    = msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C5",
                     subcategory = "GO:BP")
)
pathways <- lapply(collections, function(x) split(x$gene_symbol, x$gs_name))

for (name in names(pathways)) {
  cat(sprintf("  %s: %d gene sets\n", name, length(pathways[[name]])))
}
```

## 5.2 Build ranks (RPS/RPL filtered)

```{r gsea-ranks}
ranks_loy_ctrl <- prep_ranks_t(de_loy_ctrl)
cat(sprintf("Ranked gene list: %d genes\n", length(ranks_loy_ctrl)))

ribo_hits <- grep("^RPS\\d|^RPL\\d", names(ranks_loy_ctrl), value = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("Removing %d ribosomal protein genes (RPS/RPL)\n",
            length(ribo_hits)))
ranks_loy_ctrl <- ranks_loy_ctrl[!names(ranks_loy_ctrl) %in% ribo_hits]
cat(sprintf("After RPS/RPL filter: %d genes\n", length(ranks_loy_ctrl)))
```

## 5.3 Run fgsea and save

```{r gsea-run}
set.seed(42)
cat("Running fgsea (basic collections) for LOY vs sgCTRL...\n")
gsea_loy_ctrl <- run_fgsea_all(ranks_loy_ctrl, pathways)

fwrite(gsea_loy_ctrl, file.path(GSEA_DIR, "ht1080_LOY_v_sgCTRL_gsea.csv"))
```

## 5.4 Summary

```{r gsea-summary}
gsea_loy_ctrl %>%
  group_by(collection) %>%
  summarize(
    total    = n(),
    sig_up   = sum(padj < 0.05 & NES > 0),
    sig_down = sum(padj < 0.05 & NES < 0),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "LOY vs sgCTRL — Significant pathways by collection")
```

## 5.5 Publication dotplot

```{r gsea-dotplot-pub, fig.height=6, fig.width=5.5}
pub_dot <- gsea_loy_ctrl %>%

    pathway_clean = gsub("^HALLMARK_|^REACTOME_|^KEGG_|^GOBP_|^GO_",

                          override.aes = list(fill = "grey50"))) +

    plot.caption     = element_text(size = 5.5, hjust = 0, face = "italic"),
    plot.margin      = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )

print(p_dot_basic)
save_fig(p_dot_basic, "gsea_dotplot_basic", width = 5.5, height = 6)
```

# 7. Chromatin / PRC2 Deep Dive

Polycomb / bivalent gene sets (MIKKELSEN H3K27me3 / H3K4me3+H3K27me3 bivalent
sets, MEISSNER bivalent sets, BENPORATH PRC2 / SUZ12 targets, KAMMINGA EZH2
targets, PASINI SUZ12 targets) all converge on developmental genes that in
normal cells carry H3K27me3 and/or bivalent H3K4me3+H3K27me3 promoter marks.
Coordinated regulation of these sets points at a chromatin-state shift in LOY
rather than scattered single-gene effects. The same query is applied to HT1080
here for direct comparison with the HT1080 result.

## 7.1 Chromatin pathway dotplot

```{r gsea-chromatin-dotplot, fig.height=7, fig.width=6.5}

                grepl(chromatin_pattern, pathway, ignore.case = TRUE),

    pathway_clean = sub("^[A-Z]+_", "", pathway),
    pathway_clean = gsub("_", " ", pathway_clean),
    pathway_clean = str_to_title(pathway_clean),
    pathway_clean = str_wrap(pathway_clean, 42),
    sig_label = case_when(
      padj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      padj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      padj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ ""
    ),
    pathway_label = paste0(pathway_clean, "  ", sig_label),
    pathway_label = fct_reorder(pathway_label, NES)
  )

if (nrow(chrom_dot) > 0) {
  p_chrom <- ggplot(chrom_dot,
                    aes(x = NES, y = pathway_label,
                        size = -log10(padj), fill = NES)) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.3) +

                         midpoint = 0, name = "NES",

    scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 5),
                          name = expression(-log[10](p[adj])),
                          guide = guide_legend(
                            override.aes = list(shape = 21, fill = "grey50"))) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
    labs(x = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)", y = NULL,
         title = "HT1080 LOY vs sgCTRL — Chromatin / PRC2 (CGP, padj < 0.25)",
         subtitle = "← Enriched in sgCTRL      Enriched in LOY →",
         caption = paste(
           "Filter: H3K27ME3 / H3K4ME2/3 / PRC2 / EZH2 / SUZ12 / POLYCOMB.",
           "* padj<0.05  ** <0.01  *** <0.001", sep = "\n")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 6.5, lineheight = 0.85),
      axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.title.x     = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.title       = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 7.5, hjust = 0.5, face = "italic"),
      legend.title     = element_text(size = 7),

      legend.key.size  = unit(0.3, "cm"),
      plot.caption     = element_text(size = 6, hjust = 0, face = "italic")
    )

  print(p_chrom)
  save_fig(p_chrom, "gsea_dotplot_chromatin", width = 6.5, height = 7)

  cat("\nChromatin pathways at padj < 0.05:\n")
  chrom_dot %>%
    dplyr::filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::select(pathway, NES, pval, padj, size) %>%
    knitr::kable(caption = "HT1080 LOY vs sgCTRL — significant chromatin pathways")
} else {
  cat("No chromatin pathways match the filter at padj < 0.25.\n")
}
```

## 7.3 H3K27me3 target gene volcano

Highlight `MIKKELSEN_MEF_HCP_WITH_H3K27ME3` member genes (bivalent-promoter
developmental regulators carrying H3K27me3 in MEFs) on the full DE volcano.

```{r chromatin-volcano, fig.height=6, fig.width=7.5}
chromatin_set <- pathways_expanded$cgp[["MIKKELSEN_MEF_HCP_WITH_H3K27ME3"]]

if (!is.null(chromatin_set)) {
  chrom_vol_df <- de_loy_ctrl %>%
    mutate(
      nlp = -log10(pmax(PValue, 1e-300)),
      in_set = gene_name %in% chromatin_set,
      cat = case_when(
        !in_set                              ~ "Other",
        in_set & PValue < 0.05 & logFC >  0  ~ "H3K27me3 target — Up",
        in_set & PValue < 0.05 & logFC <  0  ~ "H3K27me3 target — Down",
        TRUE                                  ~ "H3K27me3 target — NS"
      ),
      cat = factor(cat,
                   levels = c("Other", "H3K27me3 target — NS",
                              "H3K27me3 target — Down",
                              "H3K27me3 target — Up"))
    )

  set_de <- chrom_vol_df %>% dplyr::filter(in_set)
  cat(sprintf("H3K27me3 set genes in DE: %d\n", nrow(set_de)))
  cat(sprintf("  nom. p < 0.05 & up:   %d\n",
              sum(set_de$PValue < 0.05 & set_de$logFC > 0)))
  cat(sprintf("  nom. p < 0.05 & down: %d\n",
              sum(set_de$PValue < 0.05 & set_de$logFC < 0)))

  label_set <- set_de %>%
    dplyr::filter(PValue < 0.05) %>%
    slice_min(PValue, n = 25)

  chrom_cols <- c("Other"                     = "grey85",
                  "H3K27me3 target — NS"      = "#FDAE61",
                  "H3K27me3 target — Down"    = "#0072B2",
                  "H3K27me3 target — Up"      = "#D55E00")

  p_chrom_vol <- ggplot(chrom_vol_df, aes(x = logFC, y = nlp, color = cat)) +
    geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(., cat == "Other"),
               alpha = 0.4, size = 1) +
    geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(., cat == "H3K27me3 target — NS"),
               alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8) +
    geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(.,
               !cat %in% c("Other", "H3K27me3 target — NS")),
               alpha = 0.85, size = 2.2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = label_set, aes(label = gene_name),
      size = 3, fontface = "italic",
      max.overlaps = Inf, segment.color = "grey50", segment.size = 0.3,
      box.padding = 0.4, min.segment.length = 0.2
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = chrom_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      x = expression(log[2]~"Fold Change (LOY / sgCTRL)"),
      y = expression(-log[10]~"(P-value)"),
      title = "HT1080 LOY: MIKKELSEN MEF H3K27me3 bivalent targets",
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.text     = element_text(size = 9),
      plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 12)
    )

  print(p_chrom_vol)
  save_fig(p_chrom_vol, "volcano_h3k27me3_targets", width = 7.5, height = 6)
} else {
  cat("MIKKELSEN_MEF_HCP_WITH_H3K27ME3 not found in CGP collection.\n")
}
```

# 8. NRAS Signalling & the Cell-Cycle Paradox

**The paradox.** GSEA in sections 5–6 typically shows **cell-cycle pathways
enriched in HT1080 LOY** (HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS, G2M_CHECKPOINT, MYC_TARGETS) —
yet HT1080 LOY cells show no proliferation advantage over sgCTRL in growth
assays. Why does a transcriptional push toward cell-cycle progression fail to
translate into more cells?

**Working hypothesis.** HT1080 carries an activating **NRAS Q61K** mutation
(COSMIC CCLE entry). NRAS Q61K is a constitutively active oncoprotein that
drives MAPK and PI3K signalling into the cell-cycle machinery regardless of
upstream input. In a cell already running RAS at saturation, a further
LOY-induced bump in cell-cycle transcription may hit a ceiling downstream —
receptor-level / metabolic / DNA-replication bottlenecks cap actual
proliferation, while transcription still "writes the order" at E2F / MYC.
This section unpacks the transcriptional side of that story.

## 8.1 NRAS / cell-cycle pathway dotplot

```{r gsea-nras-dotplot, fig.height=6, fig.width=6.5}
nras_pattern <- paste(c(
  "KRAS_SIGNALING", "NRAS", "MAPK", "MTORC1", "PI3K_AKT",
  "E2F_TARGETS", "G2M_CHECKPOINT", "MYC_TARGETS",
  "MITOTIC_SPINDLE", "DNA_REPAIR"
), collapse = "|")

nras_combined <- bind_rows(
  gsea_loy_ctrl %>% dplyr::filter(collection == "hallmark"),
  gsea_loy_ctrl_expanded %>%
    dplyr::filter(collection %in% c("cp_reactome", "cp_kegg_med",
                                    "cp_wikipath"))
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl(nras_pattern, pathway, ignore.case = TRUE),
                padj < 0.25) %>%
  distinct(pathway, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    pathway_clean = gsub("^HALLMARK_|^REACTOME_|^WP_|^KEGG_MEDICUS_",
                         "", pathway),
    pathway_clean = gsub("_", " ", pathway_clean),
    pathway_clean = str_to_title(pathway_clean),
    pathway_clean = str_wrap(pathway_clean, 42),
    sig_label = case_when(
      padj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      padj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      padj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ ""
    ),
    pathway_label = paste0(pathway_clean, "  ", sig_label),
    pathway_label = fct_reorder(pathway_label, NES)
  )

if (nrow(nras_combined) > 0) {
  p_nras_dot <- ggplot(nras_combined,
                       aes(x = NES, y = pathway_label,
                           size = -log10(padj), fill = NES)) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey85", high = "#B2182B",
                         midpoint = 0, name = "NES",
                         guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 0.5, barheight = 3)) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 5),
                          name = expression(-log[10](p[adj])),
                          guide = guide_legend(
                            override.aes = list(shape = 21, fill = "grey50"))) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
    labs(x = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)", y = NULL,
         title = "HT1080 LOY vs sgCTRL — RAS / MAPK / PI3K / cell-cycle",
         subtitle = "← Enriched in sgCTRL      Enriched in LOY →",
         caption = "Hallmark + Reactome + KEGG Medicus + WikiPathways; padj < 0.25.") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 6.5, lineheight = 0.85),
      axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.title.x     = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.title       = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 7.5, hjust = 0.5, face = "italic"),
      legend.title     = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 6),
      legend.key.size  = unit(0.3, "cm"),
      plot.caption     = element_text(size = 6, hjust = 0, face = "italic")
    )

  print(p_nras_dot)
  save_fig(p_nras_dot, "gsea_dotplot_nras_cellcycle",
           width = 6.5, height = 6)
} else {
  cat("No matching RAS / cell-cycle pathways at padj < 0.25.\n")
}
```

## 8.3 Cell-cycle gene overlay on volcano

Highlight Hallmark **E2F_TARGETS** member genes on the full DE volcano — shows
whether the cell-cycle enrichment comes from many small coordinated shifts
("lots of small nudges, not a few big hits") or a handful of outliers.

```{r e2f-volcano, fig.height=6, fig.width=7.5}
e2f_set <- pathways$hallmark[["HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS"]]

if (!is.null(e2f_set)) {
  e2f_vol_df <- de_loy_ctrl %>%
    mutate(
      nlp = -log10(pmax(PValue, 1e-300)),
      in_set = gene_name %in% e2f_set,
      cat = case_when(
        !in_set                             ~ "Other",
        in_set & PValue < 0.05 & logFC > 0  ~ "E2F target — Up",
        in_set & PValue < 0.05 & logFC < 0  ~ "E2F target — Down",
        TRUE                                 ~ "E2F target — NS"
      ),
      cat = factor(cat,
                   levels = c("Other", "E2F target — NS",
                              "E2F target — Down", "E2F target — Up"))
    )

  set_de_e2f <- e2f_vol_df %>% dplyr::filter(in_set)
  cat(sprintf("E2F_TARGETS genes in DE: %d\n", nrow(set_de_e2f)))
  cat(sprintf("  nom. p<0.05 & up:   %d\n",
              sum(set_de_e2f$PValue < 0.05 & set_de_e2f$logFC > 0)))
  cat(sprintf("  nom. p<0.05 & down: %d\n",
              sum(set_de_e2f$PValue < 0.05 & set_de_e2f$logFC < 0)))

  label_e2f <- set_de_e2f %>%
    dplyr::filter(PValue < 0.05) %>%
    slice_min(PValue, n = 25)

  e2f_cols <- c("Other"              = "grey85",
                "E2F target — NS"    = "#FDAE61",
                "E2F target — Down"  = "#0072B2",
                "E2F target — Up"    = "#D55E00")

  p_e2f_vol <- ggplot(e2f_vol_df, aes(x = logFC, y = nlp, color = cat)) +
    geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(., cat == "Other"),
               alpha = 0.4, size = 1) +
    geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(., cat == "E2F target — NS"),
               alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8) +
    geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(.,
               !cat %in% c("Other", "E2F target — NS")),
               alpha = 0.85, size = 2.2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = label_e2f, aes(label = gene_name),
      size = 3, fontface = "italic",
      max.overlaps = Inf, segment.color = "grey50", segment.size = 0.3,
      box.padding = 0.4, min.segment.length = 0.2
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = e2f_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      x = expression(log[2]~"Fold Change (LOY / sgCTRL)"),
      y = expression(-log[10]~"(P-value)"),
      title = "HT1080 LOY: Hallmark E2F_TARGETS gene overlay",
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.text     = element_text(size = 9),
      plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 12)
    )

  print(p_e2f_vol)
  save_fig(p_e2f_vol, "volcano_e2f_targets", width = 7.5, height = 6)
}
```

## 8.4 Expression of NRAS and key cell-cycle / proliferation genes

Per-sample logCPM for the key players. If cell-cycle transcription is "writing
the order" but proliferation doesn't rise, expect E2F targets up in LOY at the
transcript level, but proliferation markers (MKI67) and the cyclins that
bottleneck progression (CCND1, CCNE1) to **not** change appreciably.

```{r nras-cellcycle-boxplots, fig.height=7, fig.width=10}
lcpm_sym <- cpm(dge_lc, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)
rownames(lcpm_sym) <- dge_lc$genes$gene_name

focus_genes <- c(
  # RAS / MAPK / PI3K axis
  "NRAS", "MAPK1", "MAPK3", "DUSP6", "SPRY2",
  # Cell-cycle TFs / cyclins / CDKs
  "MYC", "E2F1", "E2F2", "CCND1", "CCNE1", "CDK4", "CDK2",
  # Proliferation markers
  "MKI67", "PCNA"
)
focus_genes <- focus_genes[focus_genes %in% rownames(lcpm_sym)]
cat("Focus genes present in DGE:", length(focus_genes), "\n")

box_df <- lcpm_sym[focus_genes, , drop = FALSE] %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "sample", values_to = "logCPM") %>%
  left_join(
    dge_lc$samples %>%
      rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
      dplyr::select(sample, treatment, passage),
    by = "sample"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("CTRL", "LOY")),
    gene      = factor(gene, levels = focus_genes)
  )

de_ann <- de_loy_ctrl %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene_name %in% focus_genes) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene = gene_name, logFC, FDR) %>%
  mutate(lab = sprintf("lfc %.2f\nFDR %.2g", logFC, FDR))

p_box_focus <- ggplot(box_df, aes(x = treatment, y = logCPM, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.4, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = passage), size = 2,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.1, seed = 1)) +
  geom_text(data = de_ann,
            aes(x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = lab),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = 1.2, size = 2.7,
            color = "grey30") +
  facet_wrap(~ gene, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("CTRL" = "#009E73", "LOY" = "#E69F00"),
                    guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = passage_shapes, name = "Passage") +
  labs(title = "HT1080 — NRAS pathway and cell-cycle gene expression",
       subtitle = "logCPM per sample; paired DE lfc and FDR shown per gene",
       x = NULL, y = expression(log[2]~"(CPM)")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
  )

print(p_box_focus)
save_fig(p_box_focus, "nras_cellcycle_boxplots", width = 10, height = 7)
```

**Read this plot as:** Does NRAS itself move? (Likely not — it's the activating
Q61K mutation that matters, not transcript level.) Do downstream E2F / MYC /
cyclin transcripts move up in LOY? (Expected yes — this is the "paradox"
signal.) Do the ultimate proliferation markers (MKI67, PCNA) move? (If they
stay flat, that's the downstream bottleneck — the cells *transcribe* a faster
program but don't *run* it faster.)

# 9. TF Regulon Activity (DoRothEA + decoupleR)

Two orthogonal methods to infer which transcription factors drive the
LOY-vs-sgCTRL transcriptional program:

1. **DoRothEA + fgsea** — regulon-enrichment of MoR-weighted t-stats.
2. **decoupleR ULM (CollecTRI network)** — univariate linear model applied
   sample-by-sample (heatmap) and on the contrast t-stats (bar/volcano/scatter).

Both methods use the paired-design DE (`de_loy_ctrl`) and the ribo-filtered
t-stat ranks (`ranks_loy_ctrl`).

## 9.1 Load DoRothEA regulons

```{r tf-setup}
tf_regulons_raw <- dorothea_hs_pancancer %>%
  dplyr::filter(confidence %in% c("A", "B", "C")) %>%
  dplyr::select(tf, target, mor)

tf_regulons <- tf_regulons_raw %>%
  split(.$tf) %>%
  lapply(function(x) unique(x$target))

tf_mor <- tf_regulons_raw %>%
  group_by(tf, target) %>%
  summarise(mor = mean(mor), .groups = "drop") %>%
  split(.$tf) %>%
  lapply(function(x) setNames(x$mor, x$target))

cat(sprintf("Loaded %d TF regulons (A/B/C)\n", length(tf_regulons)))
regulon_sizes <- sapply(tf_regulons, length)
cat(sprintf("Regulon size range: %d - %d (median: %d)\n",
            min(regulon_sizes), max(regulon_sizes), median(regulon_sizes)))

adjust_stats_by_mor <- function(stats, tf_name) {
  mor_vec <- tf_mor[[tf_name]]
  stats_adj <- stats
  shared <- intersect(names(mor_vec), names(stats_adj))
  stats_adj[shared] <- stats_adj[shared] * mor_vec[shared]
  sort(stats_adj, decreasing = TRUE)
}
```

## 9.2 Run fgsea on MoR-weighted ranks

```{r tf-fgsea}
set.seed(42)
tf_gsea_list <- lapply(names(tf_regulons), function(tf_name) {
  targets <- tf_regulons[[tf_name]]
  shared  <- intersect(targets, names(ranks_loy_ctrl))
  if (length(shared) < 7) return(NULL)
  stats_adj <- adjust_stats_by_mor(ranks_loy_ctrl, tf_name)
  suppressWarnings(fgsea(
    pathways = setNames(list(shared), tf_name),
    stats    = stats_adj,
    minSize  = 7,
    maxSize  = 500
  ))
})

tf_gsea_lc <- bind_rows(tf_gsea_list) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(padj = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH")) %>%
  arrange(padj)

cat(sprintf("Significant TFs (padj < 0.05): %d\n",
            sum(tf_gsea_lc$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)))

fwrite(tf_gsea_lc, file.path(TF_DIR, "ht1080_LOY_v_sgCTRL_tf_activity.csv"))
```

## 9.4 TF activity volcano

```{r tf-volcano, fig.height=5, fig.width=6}
tf_vol_data <- tf_gsea_lc %>%
  mutate(
    nlp = -log10(pmax(padj, 1e-50)),
    sig = padj < 0.05,
    direction = case_when(
      sig & NES > 0 ~ "Activated",
      sig & NES < 0 ~ "Repressed",

    ),

  )

tf_top_labels <- bind_rows(
  tf_vol_data %>% dplyr::filter(direction == "Activated") %>% slice_min(padj, n = 10),
  tf_vol_data %>% dplyr::filter(direction == "Repressed") %>% slice_min(padj, n = 10)
)

n_rep <- sum(tf_vol_data$direction == "Repressed")

p_tf_vol <- ggplot(tf_vol_data, aes(x = NES, y = nlp)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = direction), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = tf_top_labels, aes(label = pathway),
    size = 3, fontface = "bold.italic",
    max.overlaps = Inf, segment.color = "grey50", segment.size = 0.2,
    box.padding = 0.4, point.padding = 0.2, min.segment.length = 0.1,
    force = 2
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Repressed" = "#0072B2", "NS" = "grey80",
                                "Activated" = "#D55E00"), drop = FALSE) +
  annotate("text", x = max(tf_vol_data$NES) * 0.7,
           y = max(tf_vol_data$nlp) * 0.95,
           label = paste0("n = ", n_act), color = "#D55E00",
           fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
  annotate("text", x = min(tf_vol_data$NES) * 0.7,
           y = max(tf_vol_data$nlp) * 0.95,
           label = paste0("n = ", n_rep), color = "#0072B2",
           fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "HT1080: TF Activity — LOY vs sgCTRL (DoRothEA)",
    x = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)",
    y = expression(-log[10]~"(adjusted p-value)"),
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))

print(p_tf_vol)
save_fig(p_tf_vol, "tf_volcano_LOY_v_sgCTRL", width = 6, height = 5)
```

## 9.7 TF regulon overlay on DE volcano (top 6)

```{r tf-regulon-volcano, fig.height=18, fig.width=12}
make_regulon_volcano <- function(tf_name, de_data, regulon_genes, nes, padj_val) {
  direction_label <- ifelse(nes > 0, "Activated", "Repressed")

  vol_data <- de_data %>%
    mutate(
      nlp = -log10(pmax(PValue, 1e-300)),
      is_target  = gene_name %in% regulon_genes,
      target_cat = case_when(
        !is_target                             ~ "Other",
        is_target & PValue < 0.05 & logFC < 0  ~ paste0(tf_name, " — Down"),
        is_target & PValue < 0.05 & logFC > 0  ~ paste0(tf_name, " — Up"),
        TRUE                                    ~ paste0(tf_name, " — NS")
      ),
      target_cat = factor(target_cat, levels = c(
        "Other",
        paste0(tf_name, " — NS"),
        paste0(tf_name, " — Up"),
        paste0(tf_name, " — Down")
      ))
    )

  target_de <- vol_data %>% dplyr::filter(is_target)
  n_targets <- nrow(target_de)
  n_down <- sum(target_de$PValue < 0.05 & target_de$logFC < 0)
  n_up   <- sum(target_de$PValue < 0.05 & target_de$logFC > 0)

  top_labels <- target_de %>%
    dplyr::filter(PValue < 0.05) %>%
    slice_min(PValue, n = 12)

  target_colors <- c(
    "Other" = "grey85",
    setNames("#FDAE61", paste0(tf_name, " — NS")),
    setNames("#D55E00", paste0(tf_name, " — Up")),
    setNames("#0072B2", paste0(tf_name, " — Down"))
  )

  subtitle_text <- sprintf(
    "NES = %.2f, padj = %.1e  |  %d targets (%d dn, %d up; p < 0.05)",
    nes, padj_val, n_targets, n_down, n_up)

  ggplot(vol_data, aes(x = logFC, y = nlp, color = target_cat)) +
    geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(., target_cat == "Other"),
               alpha = 0.25, size = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(., grepl("NS", target_cat)),
               alpha = 0.7, size = 1.4) +
    geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(., !grepl("NS|Other", target_cat)),
               alpha = 0.85, size = 1.9) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = top_labels, aes(label = gene_name),
      size = 2.3, fontface = "italic",
      max.overlaps = 20, segment.color = "grey40", segment.size = 0.2,
      box.padding = 0.3, point.padding = 0.2, min.segment.length = 0.15
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = target_colors, name = NULL) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
    labs(
      title    = paste0(tf_name, " Regulon (", direction_label, ")"),
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      x        = expression(log[2]~"FC (LOY / sgCTRL)"),
      y        = expression(-log[10]~"(P-value)")
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.text     = element_text(size = 6.5),
      plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 10),
      plot.subtitle   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 7, color = "grey30"),
      axis.title      = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.text       = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
      plot.margin     = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2.5, alpha = 1),
                                nrow = 2))
}

sig_tf_list <- tf_gsea_lc %>% dplyr::filter(padj < 0.05) %>% arrange(padj)
n_panels <- min(6, nrow(sig_tf_list))
regulon_plots <- list()
for (i in seq_len(n_panels)) {
  tf <- sig_tf_list$pathway[i]
  targets <- tf_regulons[[tf]]
  if (is.null(targets)) next
  regulon_plots[[tf]] <- make_regulon_volcano(
    tf, de_loy_ctrl, targets,
    sig_tf_list$NES[i], sig_tf_list$padj[i]
  )
}

if (length(regulon_plots) > 0) {
  p_tf_reg <- wrap_plots(regulon_plots, ncol = 2)
  print(p_tf_reg)
  save_fig(p_tf_reg, "tf_regulon_targets_LOY_v_sgCTRL",
           width = 12, height = 18)
}
```

## 9.10 Sample-level TF activity heatmap (top variable)

```{r decouple-heatmap, fig.height=10, fig.width=8}
n_tfs <- 30

sample_acts_mat <- sample_acts_lc %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "condition", names_from = "source",
              values_from = "score") %>%
  column_to_rownames("condition") %>%
  as.matrix()

tfs_var <- sample_acts_lc %>%
  group_by(source) %>%
  summarise(std = sd(score), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(-abs(std)) %>%
  head(n_tfs) %>%
  pull(source)

hm_mat <- scale(sample_acts_mat[, tfs_var])

ann_row <- data.frame(
  Treatment = dge_lc$samples$treatment,
  Passage   = as.character(dge_lc$samples$passage),
  row.names = rownames(hm_mat)
)
hm_ann_colors <- list(
  Treatment = treatment_cols,

)

hm_colors <- rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu"))
hm_colors_use <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(colors = hm_colors)(100)
my_breaks  <- c(seq(-2, 0, length.out = 51),
                seq(0.05, 2, length.out = 50))

hm_png <- file.path(FIG_DIR, "decouple_TF_heatmap_LOY_v_sgCTRL.png")
hm_pdf <- file.path(FIG_DIR, "decouple_TF_heatmap_LOY_v_sgCTRL.pdf")

pheatmap(
  mat               = hm_mat,

  annotation_row    = ann_row,
  annotation_colors = hm_ann_colors,
  treeheight_row    = 20, treeheight_col = 20,
  main              = "decoupleR ULM: Top Variable TFs (HT1080)",

pheatmap(

  main              = "decoupleR ULM: Top Variable TFs (HT1080)",

# Inline render for HTML
pheatmap(

  color             = hm_colors_use,

  border_color      = "white",
  annotation_row    = ann_row,

cat(sprintf("Saved: decouple_TF_heatmap_LOY_v_sgCTRL.(png|pdf) [8x10 in]\n"))
```

```{r decouple-contrast-ulm}
deg_df <- de_loy_ctrl %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(t)) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_name, t) %>%
  distinct(gene_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(deg_df) <- deg_df$gene_name
deg_mat <- as.matrix(deg_df[, "t", drop = FALSE])

contrast_acts_lc <- run_ulm(
  mat = deg_mat, net = net,
  .source = "source", .target = "target", .mor = "mor",
  minsize = 5)

cat(sprintf("Contrast-level ULM: %d TFs scored\n", nrow(contrast_acts_lc)))
```

## 9.12 TF activity bar plot

```{r decouple-barplot, fig.height=8, fig.width=6}
n_show <- 25

f_contrast <- contrast_acts_lc %>% mutate(rnk = NA_real_)
msk <- f_contrast$score > 0
f_contrast$rnk[msk]  <- rank(-f_contrast$score[msk])
f_contrast$rnk[!msk] <- rank(-abs(f_contrast$score[!msk]))

top_tfs_dc <- f_contrast %>% arrange(rnk) %>% head(n_show) %>% pull(source)

f_plot <- f_contrast %>%
  dplyr::filter(source %in% top_tfs_dc) %>%
  mutate(source = reorder(source, score))

bar_colors <- c("#0072B2", "#D55E00")

p_bar <- ggplot(f_plot, aes(x = source, y = score)) +
  geom_bar(aes(fill = score), color = "black",
           stat = "identity", width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = bar_colors[1], mid = "whitesmoke",
                       high = bar_colors[2], midpoint = 0) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "TF Activity Score (ULM)",
       title = "decoupleR: Top TF Activities — HT1080 LOY vs sgCTRL") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))

print(p_bar)
save_fig(p_bar, "decouple_TF_barplot_LOY_v_sgCTRL", width = 6, height = 8)
```

## 9.13 Contrast-level TF volcano (decoupleR)

```{r decouple-volcano, fig.height=5, fig.width=6}
dc_vol <- contrast_acts_lc %>%
  mutate(
    sig = p_value < 0.05,
    direction = case_when(
      sig & score > 0 ~ "Activated",
      sig & score < 0 ~ "Repressed",
      TRUE            ~ "NS"
    ),
    direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Repressed", "NS", "Activated")),
    nlp = -log10(pmax(p_value, 1e-50))
  )

dc_top <- bind_rows(
  dc_vol %>% dplyr::filter(direction == "Activated") %>% slice_min(p_value, n = 10),
  dc_vol %>% dplyr::filter(direction == "Repressed") %>% slice_min(p_value, n = 10)
)

n_act_dc <- sum(dc_vol$direction == "Activated")
n_rep_dc <- sum(dc_vol$direction == "Repressed")

p_dc_vol <- ggplot(dc_vol, aes(x = score, y = nlp)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = direction), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text_repel(data = dc_top, aes(label = source),
                  size = 3, fontface = "bold.italic",
                  max.overlaps = Inf, segment.color = "grey50",
                  segment.size = 0.2, box.padding = 0.4, force = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Repressed" = "#0072B2", "NS" = "grey80",
                                "Activated" = "#D55E00"), drop = FALSE) +
  annotate("text", x = max(dc_vol$score) * 0.7,
           y = max(dc_vol$nlp) * 0.95,
           label = paste0("n = ", n_act_dc), color = "#D55E00",
           fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
  annotate("text", x = min(dc_vol$score) * 0.7,
           y = max(dc_vol$nlp) * 0.95,
           label = paste0("n = ", n_rep_dc), color = "#0072B2",
           fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "decoupleR TF Activity — HT1080 LOY vs sgCTRL",
    x = "TF Activity Score (ULM)",
    y = expression(-log[10]~"(p-value)"),
    color = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))

print(p_dc_vol)
save_fig(p_dc_vol, "decouple_TF_volcano_LOY_v_sgCTRL",
         width = 6, height = 5)
```

## 9.14 Target gene scatter for top TFs (decoupleR)

```{r decouple-scatter, fig.height=8, fig.width=14}
top_act_dc <- contrast_acts_lc %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_value < 0.05, score > 0) %>%
  arrange(p_value) %>% head(3) %>% pull(source)
top_rep_dc <- contrast_acts_lc %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_value < 0.05, score < 0) %>%
  arrange(p_value) %>% head(3) %>% pull(source)
scatter_tfs <- c(top_act_dc, top_rep_dc)

de_for_scatter <- de_loy_ctrl %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_name, logFC, t, PValue) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(t)) %>%
  distinct(gene_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(de_for_scatter) <- de_for_scatter$gene_name

scatter_colors <- c("1" = "#D55E00", "2" = "#0072B2", "3" = "grey70")

scatter_plots <- lapply(scatter_tfs, function(tf) {
  df <- net %>%
    dplyr::filter(source == tf) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(target) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(ID = target) %>%
    distinct(target, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  rownames(df) <- df$target

  inter <- sort(intersect(rownames(de_for_scatter), rownames(df)))
  if (length(inter) < 3) return(NULL)

  df <- df[inter, ]
  df[, c("logfc", "t_value", "p_value")] <-
    de_for_scatter[inter, c("logFC", "t", "PValue")]

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(color = case_when(
      mor > 0 & t_value > 0 ~ "1",
      mor > 0 & t_value < 0 ~ "2",
      mor < 0 & t_value > 0 ~ "2",
      mor < 0 & t_value < 0 ~ "1",
      TRUE                  ~ "3"
    ))

  act_score <- contrast_acts_lc %>%
    dplyr::filter(source == tf) %>% pull(score) %>% round(2)
  pv <- contrast_acts_lc %>%
    dplyr::filter(source == tf) %>% pull(p_value) %>% signif(2)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = logfc, y = -log10(p_value), color = color)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, color = "black") +
    geom_point(size = 1.5) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = scatter_colors,
                        labels = c("1" = "Concordant",
                                   "2" = "Discordant",
                                   "3" = "Neutral"),
                        name = "MoR") +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = ID), size = 2.1, max.overlaps = 15,
                    segment.size = 0.2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
    labs(title = paste0(tf, " (score=", act_score, ", p=", pv, ")"),
         x = expression(log[2]~"FC (LOY / sgCTRL)"),
         y = expression(-log[10]~"(P-value)")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))
})

scatter_plots <- compact(scatter_plots)
if (length(scatter_plots) > 0) {
  p_dc_scatter <- wrap_plots(scatter_plots, ncol = 3)
  print(p_dc_scatter)
  save_fig(p_dc_scatter, "decouple_TF_target_scatter_LOY_v_sgCTRL",
           width = 14, height = 8)
}
```

## 9.15 Save decoupleR results

```{r decouple-save}
fwrite(sample_acts_lc,
       file.path(TF_DIR, "ht1080_decoupleR_sample_activities.csv"))
fwrite(contrast_acts_lc,
       file.path(TF_DIR, "ht1080_decoupleR_contrast_activities.csv"))
cat("decoupleR results saved to:", TF_DIR, "\n")
```

**Interpretation.** The DoRothEA fgsea and decoupleR ULM analyses both infer
TF activity from the coordinated regulation of each TF's downstream targets —
not from the TF's own mRNA level. Agreement between the two methods on a TF
(e.g., same direction in both volcanos) is the strongest evidence that the
TF's activity is altered in LOY. Differences can reflect (i) method weighting,
(ii) regulon source (DoRothEA pancancer vs CollecTRI), or (iii) which targets
were measured in this dataset.

# 10. Top-DEG Expression Boxplots {.tabset}

Per-sample logCPM for the strongest individual differentially-expressed genes
(paired DE, Y-chr removed) — the individual-gene complement to the GSEA
pathway view.

```{r top-deg-setup}
# Full-sample (LOY + CTRL + PARENTAL) logCPM matrix, symbol-keyed.
# Used by the "with PARENTAL" boxplot tabs to show parental expression as
# the untreated baseline alongside the LOY vs sgCTRL contrast.
lcpm_sym_full <- cpm(dge, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)
rownames(lcpm_sym_full) <- dge$genes$gene_name

box_genes <- function(genes_to_plot, title, include_parental = FALSE) {
  if (include_parental) {
    mat        <- lcpm_sym_full
    dge_obj    <- dge
    trt_levels <- c("PARENTAL", "CTRL", "LOY")
    ann_x      <- 2.5  # between CTRL (x=2) and LOY (x=3)
    sub_extra  <- "; PARENTAL shown as untreated baseline"
  } else {
    mat        <- lcpm_sym
    dge_obj    <- dge_lc
    trt_levels <- c("CTRL", "LOY")
    ann_x      <- 1.5  # between CTRL (x=1) and LOY (x=2)
    sub_extra  <- ""
  }

  genes_to_plot <- intersect(genes_to_plot, rownames(mat))
  if (length(genes_to_plot) == 0) return(NULL)

  df <- mat[genes_to_plot, , drop = FALSE] %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "sample", values_to = "logCPM") %>%
    left_join(
      dge_obj$samples %>%
        rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
        dplyr::select(sample, treatment, passage),
      by = "sample"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      treatment = factor(treatment, levels = trt_levels),
      gene      = factor(gene, levels = genes_to_plot)
    )

  ann <- de_loy_ctrl %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene_name %in% genes_to_plot) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene = gene_name, logFC, FDR) %>%
    mutate(lab = sprintf("lfc %.2f\nFDR %.2g", logFC, FDR))

  ggplot(df, aes(x = treatment, y = logCPM, fill = treatment)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.4, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = passage), size = 2,
               position = position_jitter(width = 0.1, seed = 1)) +
    geom_text(data = ann,
              aes(x = ann_x, y = Inf, label = lab),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = 1.2, size = 2.7,
              color = "grey30") +
    facet_wrap(~ gene, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = treatment_cols, guide = "none") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = passage_shapes, name = "Passage") +
    labs(title = title,
         subtitle = paste0("logCPM per sample; paired DE lfc and FDR annotated",
                           sub_extra),
         x = NULL, y = expression(log[2]~"(CPM)")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
    )
}

top_up <- de_loy_ctrl %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR < ALPHA, logFC >  LFC_THR) %>%
  slice_min(FDR, n = 20) %>%
  pull(gene_name)

top_dn <- de_loy_ctrl %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR < ALPHA, logFC < -LFC_THR) %>%
  slice_min(FDR, n = 20) %>%
  pull(gene_name)

cat(sprintf("Top up   (FDR<%g & lfc>%g):  %d genes\n",
            ALPHA, LFC_THR, length(top_up)))
cat(sprintf("Top down (FDR<%g & lfc<-%g): %d genes\n",
            ALPHA, LFC_THR, length(top_dn)))
```
